run_simulator_with_rigid_objects: run the habitat-sim simulator tutorial to add and simulate rigid objects like spheres in a 3D scene
simulate_physics_with_velocity_control: simulate physics for kinematic objects using velocity control to set linear and angular velocity in habitat-sim
create_embodied_agent_with_navmesh: create an embodied agent robot attached to a scene node and navigate it using navmesh step filtering
build_object_template_configurations: build object template configurations by loading sphere and box configs from JSON files into the object template manager
test_kinematic_object_interactions: test kinematic object interactions by setting motion type to KINEMATIC and dropping dynamic objects onto it
